call_points.text: FY28 revenue targeted at ₹11,000-12,000 Cr, implying about 20% growth.
Standalone EBITDA margin guided at 10-11%, with only marginal improvement possible.
Capex guided at about ₹300 Cr for FY27 and ₹200-250 Cr for FY28.
₹3,346 Cr of HAM/BoT equity remains to be funded, with ₹900-1,000 Cr planned in FY27.
Bitumen price rises are compensated by a government circular, but diesel and energy costs are not.
Power transmission projects get no escalation, so aluminium and copper volatility hits margins.
The company targets transferring at least 3-4 assets to the InvIT this year.
FY27 revenue growth guided at 15%, with management saying order inflow impact comes the following year.
FY27 order intake targeted at ₹20,000-22,000 Cr, split across roads, power transmission, tunnels and oil & gas.
Remaining HAM/BOT equity contribution is ₹3,486 Cr, of which about ₹1,000 Cr is due in FY27.
Execution rate is not expected to improve, with land acquisition the biggest challenge.
Income Tax search from October 2025: company has replied, no material finding so far, show-cause notices expected.
Order book as on 31st March 2026 reached ₹26,471.5 Cr.

entities.name: GR Govindpur Rajura Highway Private Limited
GR Amritsar Bathinda Highway Private Limited

operating_notes.text: Executed ₹413.37 Cr (excl. GST) EPC agreement with NTPC for BESS Implementation at Mouda Super Thermal Power Station on 23rd April 2026.
Independent Engineer issued completion certificate for ₹907 Cr (excl. GST) Govindpur-Rajura HAM highway project with COD effective 25th March 2026.
Consolidated order book stood at ₹26,471.5 Cr as of March 31, 2026.
Provisional completion certificate issued by the Independent Engineer for the ₹927.00 Cr (excl. GST) 6-lane Amritsar-Bathinda NH-754A HAM project (39 km), COD effective 1 March 2026.
Executed concession agreement with NHAI for the ₹2,440.87 Cr (excl. GST) NH-33 greenfield HAM project through wholly owned subsidiary Munger Link Highway Private Limited.
Order book at ₹26,470 Cr as of May 2026; bids worth ₹13,500 Cr pending.
Fuel and bitumen account for about 40% of road project cost.
Remaining HAM/BOT equity contribution ₹3,486 Cr, with ₹1,000 Cr due in FY27.
Nasarpore Malotha Highway Pvt Ltd signed concession agreement with NHAI for ₹1,453.57 Cr NH-56 HAM project in Gujarat.
Promoter group announced inter-se transfer of shares by way of gift scheduled for May 28, 2026.
Order book was about ₹25,300 Cr as of 1 July 2026, with bids of about ₹32,000 Cr yet to be opened (₹28,000 Cr transportation, ₹4,000 Cr hydro and tunnels).
T&D revenue was about ₹110 Cr in Q1FY27 versus ₹75 Cr in the prior year, and oil & gas revenue was ₹270 Cr.
Working capital days rose to 148 at June 2026 from 128 at FY26-end on higher debtor and inventory days.

Fourwrd MMLP Varanasi Private Limited signed a DBFOT concession with Varanasi MMLP Limited for a ₹91.60 Cr (ex-GST) multi-modal logistics park, 45-year concession including a 1-year construction period from the appointed date.

holders.name: TATA AIA LIFE INSURANCE COMPANY LTD

timeline.summary: Executed ₹413.37 Cr EPC contract with NTPC for BESS Implementation at Mouda Super Thermal Power Station.
G R Infraprojects' wholly-owned subsidiary completed the ₹907 Cr NH-353B HAM highway project in Maharashtra with COD effective March 25, 2026.
Q4FY26 results (consolidated): revenue ₹2,500.41 Cr (+9.9% YoY), net profit ₹209.86 Cr (-47.9% YoY).
G R Infraprojects released its Q4 and FY26 investor presentation reporting consolidated revenue of ₹8,399 Cr and an order book of ₹26,472 Cr.
G R Infraprojects Limited shared the audio recording of its earnings conference call on May 12, 2026, for Q4 and FY2026, available at the provided weblink.

G R Infraprojects' wholly owned subsidiary GR Amritsar Bathinda Highway received a provisional completion certificate from the Independent Engineer on 13 May 2026 for its ₹927 Cr NH-754A HAM project, with commercial operation effective 1 March 2026.
Munger Link Highway Private Limited executed a concession agreement with NHAI on 14th May 2026 for the ₹2,440.87 Cr NH-33 greenfield HAM highway project.

G R Infraprojects' Q4 FY26 earnings call (12 May 2026) guided FY27 revenue growth of 15% and order intake of ₹20,000-22,000 Cr, with capex of ₹300-350 Cr and no margin guidance due to geopolitical cost pressure.
On May 18, 2026, GR Infraprojects announced that its wholly owned subsidiary executed a concession agreement with NHAI for a ₹1,453.57 Cr Gujarat highway HAM project.
G R Infraprojects submitted disclosures under Regulation 10(5) and Regulation 29 of SEBI SAST Regulations on May 22, 2026, regarding promoter group inter-se share transfers.
On its Q1FY27 call (7 Aug 2026), G R Infraprojects reported standalone revenue of ₹2,423 Cr (+32.71% YoY) with an 11.02% EBITDA margin, and held FY27 revenue growth guidance at 15-20%.

On 15 October 2026, wholly owned subsidiary Fourwrd MMLP Varanasi Private Limited signed a ₹91.60 Cr (ex-GST) DBFOT concession with Varanasi MMLP Limited for a 45-year multi-modal logistics park at Varanasi, with a 1-year construction period from the appointed date.
The Madhya Pradesh High Court quashed the GST show cause notice issued to G R Infraprojects by the Ratlam Division state tax office.
